supersedes: dynamic-friction-v2 MIT Push (SAP-only reconstruction; MuJoCo used box primitives with a 36-mm central table-support patch while SAP used the released meshes with a table friction of ~0.36 instead of 0.22)

fixed.geometry: released hex.obj / rect1.obj convex meshes (thickness axis y remapped to z) for the object in both engines; pusher = cylinder r 4.75 mm, half-height 15 mm, centred 10 mm above the object mid-plane so it never touches the table; table = ground plane
fixed.object_physics: mass 0.9827 kg, inertia diag(0.00075, 0.00075, 0.001497) hex / (0.00057, 0.00057, 0.001131) rect1 (dataset-documented reconstruction assumptions), table-object friction 0.22, pusher-object friction 0.25 (SAP: per-shape mu 1.0 / ground 0.1236 / pusher 0.1429 so that its harmonic pair combination gives exactly 0.22 and 0.25)
fixed.pusher_motion: recorded tip xy (registered in the object-0 frame) imposed on x/y slide joints: MuJoCo overwrites pusher qpos/qvel every step; SAP tracks it with stiff implicit PD on targets and target velocities (tracking error gated <= 0.5 mm)
fixed.perturbation: object initial xy + N(0, 0.2 mm); identical arrays for both engines
fixed.pass_gate: finite state, no contact truncation, pusher tracking within 0.5 mm (SAP)
fixed.loss: final planar translation error (m) + 0.05 x final yaw error (rad), mean over rollouts
fixed.mechanism_metrics: translation and yaw errors reported separately; windowed (0.12-0.20, 0.22-0.32, 0.40-0.50, 0.60-0.72 s) object-twist error and pusher-wrench error (force on the pusher, object-0 frame), pusher-object contact duty

selection_rule: pass gate, then loss, then wall time
seed_rule: selection: seed0; held-out cell j: seed0 + 1000 + j

candidate_rule.rationale: both span normal compliance and friction regularisation; MuJoCo uses direct stiffness/damping so refsafe does not clamp at dt = 1/90 s

held_out_conditions.axis: dt (selection trial at a held-out dt)
dt (selection trial at a held-out dt)
mass (quasi-static pushing: object pose is mass-invariant; wrench compared after dividing by the mass scale)

not_run_conditions.reason: only two plywood recordings are released in the repo; no reference for other surfaces
